quarterly_data.signal: Eli Lilly's 10-K: in the U.S., most of Lilly's products are distributed through wholesalers that serve pharmacies, physicians and other healthcare professionals, and hospitals. In 2025, 2024 and 2023, three wholesale distributors in the U.S. - McKesson Corporation, Cencora, Inc. and Cardinal Health, Inc. - each accounted for a significant percentage of consolidated revenue; no other customer accounted for more than 10 percent of consolidated revenue in any of these years. The filing's XBRL concentration facts for the three largest wholesalers show 16% and 24% of 2025 revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: three U.S. wholesalers each a significant percentage of revenue; XBRL values 16% and 24% of 2025 revenue; no other customer above 10 percent
